name: METRO
recent: Metro Healthcare Berhad 在2026年11月24日公布截至9月30日的季度业绩，第三季净利同比下滑19.85%至160.3万令吉，但首九个月净利同比增长17.0%。近期董事及财务总监出现几笔普通股买卖，同时董事局出现人事变动。
notable: 公布截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩，第三季净利同比下滑19.85%至160.3万令吉，首九个月净利同比增长17.0%。
财务总监Khoo Chiau Chi于2026年10月6日出售12万股普通股。
董事经理Lim Wai Khong于2026年9月29日增持30万股普通股。
risks: 财务总监Khoo Chiau Chi于2026年10月6日出售12万股普通股。
第三季净利同比下滑19.85%至160.3万令吉。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止季度，营收为1323.3万令吉，环比增长17.9%，同比增长4.8%；净利为150.3万令吉，环比增长50.1%，同比增长24.8%；净利率为11.4%，高于上一季度的8.9%。

recent_en: Metro Healthcare Berhad announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 24 November 2026, with 3Q net profit falling 19.85% year-on-year to RM1.603 million, while 9M net profit rose 17.0% year-on-year. There were several ordinary share dealings by directors and the financial controller, along with a boardroom change.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with 3Q net profit down 19.85% year-on-year to RM1.603 million, while 9M net profit rose 17.0% year-on-year.
Financial Controller Khoo Chiau Chi disposed of 120,000 ordinary shares on 6 October 2026.
Managing Director Lim Wai Khong acquired 300,000 ordinary shares on 29 September 2026.
risks_en: Financial Controller Khoo Chiau Chi disposed of 120,000 ordinary shares on 6 October 2026.
3Q net profit fell 19.85% year-on-year to RM1.603 million.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM13.233 million, up 17.9% QoQ and 4.8% YoY; net income was RM1.503 million, up 50.1% QoQ and 24.8% YoY; net margin was 11.4%, higher than 8.9% in the previous quarter.
